verdicts.originalText: Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment (Neuvillette's main DPS — the empowered, droplet-gated channeled CA) is not modelled. The schema has no path for Sourcewater Droplet pickups (collectibles on the field) or for the multi-tick channeled action. When 'C' is typed, the planner renders the short Charged Attack frames; in real gameplay the player would normally hold to enter Equitable Judgment.
verdicts.proposedText: Typing 'C' shows the short Charged Attack. In game, holding to charge enters Equitable Judgment, the empowered channeled attack — not modeled, since it feeds on Sourcewater Droplets picked up from the field.
verdicts.rationale: Four sentences of divergence buried under internals. Banned 'modelled' spelling, banned 'schema', and 'the planner renders' framing; names the character ('Neuvillette's main DPS'). Compressed to the one user-facing fact — 'C' shows the short CA while the real empowered hold-CA (droplet-fed) is absent. EJ is pickup-driven empowerment, explicitly out-of-scope by constitution, so this stays a legitimate rewrite, never implementDelete.

verdicts.originalText: Both effects gate on Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment, which is not modeled (see the Normal Attack caveat). The +1 base Past Draconic Glories stack would only contribute to EJ damage tiers; interrupt resistance has no planner-visible effect.
verdicts.proposedText: Both effects act on Equitable Judgment, which is not modeled — the bonus Past Draconic Glories stack only feeds its damage tiers, and the interrupt resistance has nothing to show on the timeline.
verdicts.rationale: Drops the curator cross-reference ('see the Normal Attack caveat', a pointer, not a mechanical claim) and swaps 'no planner-visible effect' for the guide's preferred 'the timeline' voice. All mechanical content preserved: both C1 effects depend on the unmodeled EJ, so neither the extra stack nor the interrupt resistance surfaces.

verdicts.originalText: Per-stack CRIT DMG bonus (+14% per Past Draconic Glories stack, max +42%) applies only to Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment, which is not modeled (see Normal Attack caveat).
verdicts.proposedText: The Past Draconic Glories CRIT DMG bonus (+14% per stack, up to +42%) applies only to Equitable Judgment, which is not modeled, so it has no effect on the timeline.
verdicts.rationale: Nearly clean already, but drops the curator cross-reference and the redundant 'Charged Attack:' prefix, and states the consequence (no timeline effect) that the sibling caveats make explicit. CRIT DMG percentages are game terms, not damage numbers, so they stay. Kept 'Past Draconic Glories' so 'per stack' is unambiguous.

verdicts.rationale: Drops the curator cross-reference and rephrases 'no planner-visible payoff' into the timeline voice; '4s ICD' rendered as the plainer 'once every 4s'. All content preserved — the healed-triggered droplet feeds the unmodeled EJ, leaving the constellation without visible payoff.
